newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan recovery moves 'half step forward'- EPA.
newsitem.headline: Japan recovery moves 'half step forward'- EPA.

text.p: Japan's government took "half a step" forward on Tuesday in its assessment of the economy, declaring that a slow recovery was underway and playing down potential worries.

In its regular report on the state of the economy, the Economic Planning Agency (EPA) struck a more upbeat note than in past months, choosing to omit a previous reference to worrying factors in the economic picture.
